concerns.text: T004 requires main.py to wire 'download → preprocess → metrics → analysis' and 'produce a preliminary data/results/analysis_results.json with real (not expected or invented) LME entries conforming to contracts/analysis.schema.yaml', but the analysis module (code/analysis.py::fit_lme, fdr_correct, check_sample_size) is first implemented in T006, which depends on T005, which depends on T004. This is a consumer-before-producer ordering violation: T004 consumes analysis code and schema-conformant LME outputs that no earlier task produces. Either T004 must explicitly include a thin-slice implementation of the LME/FDR path (a minimal fit_lme + fdr_correct sufficient for the 3-subject run), or the analysis implementation must be split out of T006 and moved before T004.
